title: introduce-budget-feedback-loop-autoscaler-and-safety-curator
author: Aisha Patel
description: Motivation: reduce manual tuning of batch/cache/quantization defaults across tenants by closing the loop between observed unit-econ telemetry and runtime configuration. This PR introduces a feedback-loop autoscaler that continuously proposes conservative adjustments to batching profile, KV-cache TTLs, and quantization preference tiers based on short-window unit-econ signals while preserving latency SLOs via a safety curator. Summary: add a controller (pkg/autoscaler/feedback_controller.go) that ingest aggregated telemetry, computes conservative parameter deltas using a capped moving-average estimator, and emits desired state to the existing runtime-config API; add a safety curator (pkg/autoscaler/safety_curator.go) that runs rapid offline simulation using sampled traces to validate proposed changes against latency and failure budgets and can veto or mark proposals for canary rollout; add rwctl CLI commands to preview/dry-run and to accept/reject proposals; expose new telemetry metrics and dashboards; extend e2e suite and tenant-sim tests. Checklist: implement controller core logic; add curator simulation harness; expose CLI and RBAC bindings; add helm defaults and chart knobs; add docs and runbook; add unit+integration+e2e tests; smoke canary rollout plan. Rollout plan: merge behind feature flag 'budget_feedback_autoscaler'; enable for internal tenant pool (canary) for 48h and monitor unit-econ and p95 latency; if green, enable progressive enablement by tenant groups with opt-out; fallback option is automatic revert to previous runtime-config snapshots. Related: builds on ENG-1421 (economics observability) and PM-468 (tenant cost controls).

review_comments: Evan Liu: This is a strong direction. Two requests before approving: 1) make the estimator cap configurable per-tenant and documented; 2) add an automated rollback threshold triggered by p95+3xstd degradation.
Aisha (author): Thanks Evan - added cap as helm/runtime-config knob and implemented rollback threshold; tests added to e2e for simulated p95 spike.
Marina Kovacs: Safety curator looks good; can you add an end-to-end smoke that runs the curator in DRY-RUN mode on stored tenant traces? This will help validate the offline sim in CI.
Aisha (author): Added smoke job autoscaler-smoke that loads a 1-min trace and validates curator decisions; CI flaked initially but stabilized after increasing simulated workload seed determinism.
Ravi Singh: CLI RBAC looks sane, but needs a unit test for permission denial paths. Also confirm that proposals are audited to tenant-level audit logs.
Aisha (author): Added CLI permission unit test and an audit entry generator; audit entries are sent to the existing audit-log pipeline (audit.log.producer).
ci_checks: e2e-autoscaler: flaky->rerun->pass (initial failure due to nondeterministic trace seed, fixed)
release_notes: Add experimental budget-feedback autoscaler: automatically proposes conservative batching/cache/quant adjustments from unit-econ signals with a safety curator validating latency SLOs. Disabled by default behind feature flag. Includes rwctl commands to preview/apply/rollback proposals and an operators runbook.
testing_summary: Unit tests cover estimator and curator logic; integration tests exercise runtime-config API and rollback path; e2e runs simulate tenant traffic and validate no-regression on p95 and error-rate under canary workloads. A short smoke job was added to CI to exercise DRY-RUN curator logic on a fixed trace. Observability: new metrics (autoscaler.proposals.count, autoscaler.proposal.outcome, autoscaler.rollback.count) and dashboards included.
rollout_notes: Feature gated behind 'budget_feedback_autoscaler'. Start with internal tenant pool for 48h, monitor autoscaler.proposals.outcome and unit-econ delta; thresholds: abort if p95 increases >5% absolute or error-rate >0.1%. Operators can force-revert with rwctl autoscale reject --proposal <id> or rollback to config snapshot via rwctl runtime-config rollback --snapshot <ts>.
notes_for_sre: Pay attention to proposal churn; curator limits proposals to one per tenant per 15m by default; added telemetry to detect oscillations (autoscaler.oscillation.alert). If oscillation detected, autoscaler disables proposals for that tenant for 1h and emits an incident event.
manual_steps: To enable in canary: helm upgrade --set featureFlags.budgetFeedbackAutosc=enabled redwood . && rwctl autoscale preview --tenant canary-01 && rwctl autoscale accept --proposal <id> (operators must have autoscale.apply RBAC role).
post_merge_todo: 1) monitor canary for 72h and gather unit-econ deltas; 2) add tenant-level UI in Console for opt-out and proposal history; 3) tune estimator hyperparameters based on canary telemetry; 4) plan progressive rollout to tenant cohorts.
authors_note: Design goals: conservative, reversible, observable. The safety curator simulates candidate changes on sampled traces to avoid blind bets. This is intentionally conservative for initial rollout; future work includes multi-tenant coordinated proposals and tighter quantization grading.
